cat > /tmp/t.py <<'EOF'
import os, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app')

def run(rank, ws):
    os.environ.update(MASTER_ADDR='127.0.0.1', MASTER_PORT='29517')
    dist.init_process_group('gloo', rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    from parallel_linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    B,I,O=3,8,12
    mw=torch.randn(O,I); x=torch.randn(B,I,requires_grad=True)
    ref=torch.nn.Linear(I,O); 
    with torch.no_grad(): ref.weight.copy_(mw); ref.bias.zero_()
    y=ref(x); y.sum().backward(); gw=ref.weight.grad.clone(); gb=ref.bias.grad.clone()

    cp=ColumnParallelLinear(I,O,True,mw.clone())
    xc=x.detach().clone().requires_grad_()
    yc=cp(xc); assert yc.shape==(B,O), yc.shape
    assert torch.allclose(yc,y,atol=1e-5)
    yc.sum().backward()
    c=O//ws
    assert cp.weight.shape==(c,I) and cp.bias.shape==(c,)
    assert torch.allclose(cp.weight, mw[rank*c:(rank+1)*c])
    assert torch.allclose(cp.weight.grad, gw[rank*c:(rank+1)*c],atol=1e-5)
    assert torch.allclose(cp.bias.grad, gb[rank*c:(rank+1)*c],atol=1e-5)
    assert torch.allclose(xc.grad, x.grad, atol=1e-5), (xc.grad-x.grad).abs().max()

    rp=RowParallelLinear(I,O,True,mw.clone())
    ci=I//ws
    xr=x.detach()[:, rank*ci:(rank+1)*ci].clone().requires_grad_()
    yr=rp(xr); assert yr.shape==(B,O)
    assert torch.allclose(yr,y,atol=1e-5)
    yr.sum().backward()
    assert rp.weight.shape==(O,ci) and rp.bias.shape==(O,)
    assert torch.allclose(rp.weight, mw[:, rank*ci:(rank+1)*ci])
    assert torch.allclose(rp.weight.grad, gw[:, rank*ci:(rank+1)*ci],atol=1e-5)
    assert torch.allclose(rp.bias.grad, gb, atol=1e-5)
    assert torch.allclose(xr.grad, x.grad[:, rank*ci:(rank+1)*ci], atol=1e-5)
    print("ok ws",ws,"rank",rank)
    dist.destroy_process_group()

if __name__=='__main__':
    for ws in (1,2,4):
        mp.spawn(run, args=(ws,), nprocs=ws, join=True)
EOF
cd /tmp && python3 t.py
